reviews.title: Overall Good Value
reviews.comment: Great aesthetics and airflow in a nice size that doesn't feel too large. Plenty of cutouts to make cable management a breeze. The 3 fans on the front are completely silent. Build quality is a bit on the cheaper end, as expected at this price range. All the thumb screws featured on the case have a horrible tendency to cross thread when trying to screw them back in and I ended up with a skinned up thumb after battling them. The back panel was a nightmare trying to reinstall after taking it off. I kept trying to put my hand on the top of the case to anchor myself while screwing things but there is a flimsy top panel that slides backwards with the slightest amount of force. For the value, however, you could certainly do a lot worse and I am satisfied with this case.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer
